recipes.name: Ackee and saltfish
recipes.summary: Jamaica's national dish: ackee fruit, which looks and behaves like scrambled egg, with soaked salt cod.

recipes.name: Chicken adobo
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in soy sauce with vinegar, garlic and bay. The vinegar is left unstirred for the first ten minutes.

recipes.name: Afghan biscuits
recipes.summary: Dense chocolate biscuits with cornflakes, under icing and half a walnut.

recipes.name: Ají de gallina
recipes.summary: Shredded chicken in a creamy sauce of ají amarillo, nuts and bread.

recipes.name: Ajiaco bogotano
recipes.summary: A chicken soup on three kinds of potato with guascas herb, capers and cream.

recipes.name: Ajvar
recipes.summary: A relish of roasted red pepper and aubergine, cooked down in oil to a thick paste.

recipes.name: Alfajores
recipes.summary: Two crumbly cornflour biscuits joined with dulce de leche and rolled in coconut.

recipes.name: Anzac biscuits
recipes.summary: Oat biscuits on golden syrup and bicarbonate, without eggs, keeping for weeks.

recipes.name: Apfelstrudel
recipes.summary: Apples with cinnamon and raisins in a dough stretched until it is transparent. It is pulled by hand, never rolled.

recipes.name: Api morado
recipes.summary: A hot thick purple corn drink with cinnamon and cloves, with fried pastries.

recipes.name: Swedish apple cake
recipes.summary: An apple cake with cinnamon under a crisp butter crumble, served with vanilla sauce.

recipes.name: Arepas
recipes.summary: Cakes of precooked corn flour, griddled and split open to be stuffed.

recipes.name: Pasuts tolma
recipes.summary: A lenten dolma of soured cabbage leaves with lentils, beans and grains.

recipes.name: Coconut rice
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in coconut milk with caramelised coconut solids, dark and faintly sweet.

recipes.name: Arroz con pollo
recipes.nativeName: Arroz con pollo a la cubana
recipes.summary: Chicken with rice cooked in beer and saffron, with peas, peppers and olives.

recipes.name: Asado
recipes.summary: Beef on a grate over wood embers, for hours, with nothing but coarse salt.

recipes.name: Asado negro
recipes.summary: Beef seared black in burnt sugar and braised for four hours.

recipes.name: Ashak
recipes.summary: Afghan leek dumplings under garlic yoghurt and a meat sauce.

recipes.name: Asida with mulah
recipes.summary: A stiff porridge of sorghum or wheat, served with stewed meat in a dried okra sauce.

recipes.name: Attiéké with fish
recipes.summary: Steamed fermented cassava couscous with grilled fish and a sharp onion salad.

recipes.name: Avgolemono
recipes.summary: Chicken soup with rice, thickened with egg beaten into lemon juice.

recipes.name: Bacalhau à brás
recipes.summary: Salt cod with matchstick potatoes and egg that binds everything without becoming an omelette.

recipes.name: Baklava
recipes.summary: Forty layers of yufka with pistachio, soaked in syrup. Hot baklava takes cold syrup, and only that way round.

recipes.name: Baleadas
recipes.summary: A wheat flour tortilla folded over refried beans, soured cream and crumbled cheese.

recipes.name: Ballokume
recipes.summary: Cornmeal biscuits from Elbasan, beaten by hand in a wooden bowl for the spring festival.

recipes.name: Bandeja paisa
recipes.summary: A tray of beans, rice, meat, crackling, egg, arepa, avocado and fried plantain.

recipes.name: Bánh mì
recipes.summary: A French baguette with Vietnamese filling: pâté, pork, pickled vegetables and coriander in one sandwich.

recipes.name: Banitsa
recipes.summary: A filo spiral with white cheese and eggs, doused in yoghurt and bicarbonate before baking.

recipes.name: Banku with tilapia
recipes.summary: Fermented maize and cassava dough worked smooth, with grilled fish and a hot pepper sauce.

recipes.name: Grilled barramundi
recipes.summary: A whole fish on the grate with lemon myrtle and lime, part in foil and part over direct heat.

recipes.name: Baursak
recipes.summary: Squares of yeast dough deep-fried into hollow puffs. The bread of the tea table and of every feast.

recipes.name: Taiwanese beef noodle soup
recipes.summary: Wheat noodles in a dark broth of beef shank with fermented bean paste and spices.

recipes.name: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.summary: Beef cut into strips and seared hard, in a soured cream sauce with onion.

recipes.name: Begova čorba
recipes.summary: A thick chicken soup with okra, bound with yolks and soured cream, a Bosnian classic.

recipes.name: Liège waffles
recipes.summary: Dense yeasted waffles from a stiff dough with pearl sugar that caramelises on the outside.

recipes.name: Beshbarmak
recipes.summary: Boiled meat on sheets of pasta with an onion broth called sorpa. The centrepiece of a Kazakh table.

recipes.name: Kyrgyz beshbarmak
recipes.summary: Mutton with home-made noodles in an onion sauce called chyk. The Kyrgyz version: mutton, and no potato.

recipes.name: Bhuna khichuri
recipes.summary: Rice and lentils fried before the water goes in. Bengali food for a rainy day.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.summary: Rice under separately cooked vegetables, meat and an egg, mixed with gochujang right before eating.

recipes.name: Bigos
recipes.summary: Sauerkraut and fresh cabbage stewed with several meats and dried fruit over three days.

recipes.name: Bint al-sahn
recipes.summary: A many-layered enriched bread brushed with ghee, drenched in honey and scattered with nigella.

recipes.name: Bircher muesli
recipes.summary: Oats soaked overnight with grated apple, cream and nuts.

recipes.name: Bitterballen
recipes.summary: Balls of stiff meat ragout in breadcrumbs, deep-fried and served with mustard.

recipes.name: Bobotie
recipes.summary: A bake of spiced mince with dried fruit under an egg and milk custard. South Africa's national dish.

recipes.name: Bolani
recipes.summary: An Afghan flatbread with a potato or leek filling, cooked on a dry pan.

recipes.name: Boorsok
recipes.summary: Kyrgyz fried dough diamonds, hollow inside, for tea and the dastarkhan.

recipes.name: Borscht
recipes.summary: A beetroot soup on beef stock where acid holds both the colour and the flavour. The beetroot is braised separately, never boiled in the pot.

recipes.name: Ukrainian borscht with pampushky
recipes.summary: Borscht on pork ribs with aged salo crushed with garlic, and garlic pampushky alongside.

recipes.name: Bosanski lonac
recipes.summary: Meat and vegetables layered in a clay pot and cooked four hours without stirring.

recipes.name: Bouillabaisse
recipes.summary: The Marseille fish soup of several species, with saffron and a rouille sauce.

recipes.name: Brik
recipes.summary: A thin sheet of pastry with an egg inside, fried so the yolk stays liquid.

recipes.name: Bryndzové halušky
recipes.summary: Potato dumplings with sheep's brynza and bacon crackling. Slovakia's national dish.

recipes.name: Bucatini all'amatriciana
recipes.summary: Guanciale, tomato and pecorino. No onion, no garlic, no olive oil — the fat comes from the meat.

recipes.name: Buffalo wings
recipes.summary: Unbreaded wings in a sauce of hot pepper sauce and butter. Salt draws the moisture out before baking.

recipes.name: Bún chả
recipes.summary: Charcoal-grilled pork in a warm sweet-sour broth, with rice vermicelli and herbs.

recipes.name: Bunny chow
recipes.summary: Half a white loaf hollowed out and filled with lamb curry.

recipes.name: Bosnian burek
recipes.summary: A spiral of hand-stretched pastry with a meat filling. In Bosnia only the meat one is called burek.

recipes.name: Buseca
recipes.summary: A thick tripe soup with white beans, chorizo and vegetables, Uruguayan winter food.

recipes.name: Butter tarts
recipes.summary: Shortcrust tartlets with a butter, sugar and syrup filling, runny or set.

recipes.name: Buuz
recipes.summary: Large steamed dumplings of chopped mutton. The centrepiece of the Mongolian lunar new year.

recipes.name: Byrek me spinaq
recipes.summary: A pie of thin pastry layered with spinach and brined cheese, each layer soaked in oil.

recipes.name: Cachapas
recipes.summary: Thick pancakes of ground fresh corn, folded around a soft white cheese.

recipes.name: Caldo verde
recipes.summary: A potato purée soup with finely shredded kale and slices of smoked chouriço.

recipes.name: Callaloo
recipes.summary: A thick purée of taro leaves with okra and coconut milk. The Trinidadian Sunday table.

recipes.name: Grilled capitaine
recipes.summary: Nile perch grilled whole over coals, with a yet onion sauce and fried plantain.

recipes.name: Carbonade flamande
recipes.summary: Beef braised in dark beer with onion and a slice of mustard-spread bread that thickens the sauce.

recipes.name: Carimañola
recipes.summary: Torpedo-shaped cassava croquettes with a meat filling, deep-fried.

recipes.name: Casado
recipes.summary: A lunch plate of rice, beans, salad, plantain and meat, each in its own sector.

recipes.name: Causa limeña
recipes.summary: Layers of yellow potato purée with lime and ají, filled with chicken or tuna.

recipes.name: Cepelinai
recipes.summary: Large potato dumplings with a meat filling, named after airships. Served with crackling and soured cream.

recipes.name: Ćevapi
recipes.summary: Skinless minced-meat sausages over coals, with raw onion and somun flatbread.

recipes.name: Ceviche
recipes.summary: Raw fish in lime juice with onion and ají. It marinates for minutes, not hours — longer and it is cooked through.

recipes.name: Ecuadorian ceviche
recipes.summary: Prawns in a tomato and lime broth, served cold with popcorn and plantain crisps.

recipes.name: Chakalaka
recipes.summary: A spicy vegetable relish of carrot, pepper and beans with curry. For a braai, for pap, or on its own.

recipes.name: Chakhokhbili
recipes.summary: Chicken stewed without water in its own juices with tomatoes and a mountain of fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Chakka
recipes.summary: Strained cultured cheese with herbs and garlic, the Tajik spread for flatbread.

recipes.name: Kenyan chapati
recipes.summary: A soft layered flatbread of wheat dough coiled into a spiral before rolling.

recipes.name: Chapli kebab
recipes.summary: Flat beef patties with cornmeal, tomato and whole coriander seeds.

recipes.name: Char kway teow
recipes.summary: Wide rice noodles seared over a very high flame with prawns, egg and bean sprouts.

recipes.name: Chawanmushi
recipes.summary: A savoury egg custard set on dashi and steamed, with a prawn and mushrooms inside.

recipes.name: Chebakia
recipes.summary: Flower-shaped biscuits deep-fried and steeped in honey with sesame.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani
recipes.summary: Rice and marinated chicken finished together under a lid: the layers cook in steam rather than by stirring.

recipes.name: Chiles rellenos
recipes.summary: Poblano peppers stuffed with cheese in an airy egg batter, fried and served under tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Chilli crab
recipes.summary: Crab in a thick tomato-chilli sauce bound with egg, mopped up with fried mantou buns.

recipes.name: Chimichurri
recipes.summary: A sauce of parsley, oregano, garlic and vinegar. A knife rather than a blender: texture matters more than smoothness.

recipes.name: Chipa
recipes.summary: Bread rings of cassava starch and cheese, with no wheat and no yeast.

recipes.name: Chivito
recipes.summary: A sandwich of thin steak, ham, bacon, cheese and a fried egg. Uruguay's national dish.

recipes.name: Chorba frik
recipes.summary: A soup of freekeh, the smoked green wheat, with lamb and mint. The first thing on the table in Ramadan.

recipes.name: Chorreadas
recipes.summary: Pancakes of ground fresh corn, served with natilla soured cream.

recipes.name: Chuchvara
recipes.summary: Tiny mutton dumplings boiled in broth, with suzma and herbs.

recipes.name: Ciorbă de burtă
recipes.summary: A sour tripe soup in a creamy garlic broth, thickened with egg yolks.

recipes.name: New England clam chowder
recipes.summary: A thick clam soup with cream, potato and bacon. No tomato — that is a matter of principle.

recipes.name: Cochinita pibil
recipes.summary: Pork in an achiote and sour orange marinade, baked in banana leaves.

recipes.name: Colcannon
recipes.summary: Mashed potato with cabbage and spring onion, a lake of melted butter in the centre.

recipes.name: Completo
recipes.summary: A hot dog under mounds of mashed avocado, tomato and mayonnaise, coloured like the Italian flag.

recipes.name: Coq au vin
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms and small onions. Marinating the day before does half the work.

recipes.name: Algerian couscous
recipes.summary: Semolina steamed three times over a pot of meat and vegetables, with the broth served apart.

recipes.name: Coxinha
recipes.summary: Deep-fried teardrops of cooked dough with a chicken filling, shaped like a drumstick.

recipes.name: Crème brûlée
recipes.summary: A yolk custard baked in a water bath under a lid of burnt sugar.

recipes.name: Black risotto
recipes.summary: Risotto with cuttlefish and its own ink. The ink goes in at the end, or it turns bitter.

recipes.name: Croissant
recipes.summary: A laminated yeasted dough with twenty-seven layers of butter. Temperature decides everything: dough and butter must be equally cold.

recipes.name: Ham croquetas
recipes.summary: A thick béchamel with ham, chilled until firm, breadcrumbed and deep-fried.

recipes.name: Curanto en olla
recipes.summary: Shellfish, meat and potato cakes cooked in layers in one pot without water.

recipes.name: Dal bhat
recipes.summary: Lentil soup with rice and a vegetable tarkari. Nepal's everyday meal, eaten twice a day for a lifetime.

recipes.name: Dal tadka
recipes.summary: A lentil stew finished by pouring sizzling spiced fat over it. That step is the dish.

recipes.name: Dobos torte
recipes.summary: Five thin sponge layers with chocolate buttercream under a caramel lid.

recipes.name: Dograma
recipes.summary: Crumbled flatbread with mutton and onion under hot broth. The Turkmen dish of Eid al-Adha.

recipes.name: Azerbaijani dolma
recipes.summary: Vine leaves with lamb, rice and mint, cooked under a weight, with garlic matsoni.

recipes.name: Iraqi dolma
recipes.summary: Vine leaves and vegetables stuffed with spiced rice and meat, layered in one pot and cooked under a weight.

recipes.name: Doro wat
recipes.summary: Chicken in a thick berbere sauce, built on a kilo of onion cooked dry until it disintegrates.

recipes.name: Doubles
recipes.summary: Two soft fried breads called bara with spiced chickpea channa between them. Trinidad's street breakfast.

recipes.name: Draniki
recipes.summary: Potato pancakes from raw grated potato, fried to a crisp edge and served with soured cream.

recipes.name: Egusi soup
recipes.summary: A thick soup of ground egusi melon seeds with greens, meat and palm oil.

recipes.name: Ema datshi
recipes.summary: Green chillies stewed in cheese. Bhutan's national dish, where chilli is a vegetable rather than a seasoning.

recipes.name: Argentinian empanadas
recipes.summary: Pastries of chopped beef, onion and egg. The filling is chilled cold, or the dough will not seal.

recipes.name: Empanadas de pino
recipes.summary: Baked pastries with a meat filling, an olive and an egg. Chilean food for 18 September and for any Sunday.

recipes.name: Encebollado
recipes.summary: A tuna soup with cassava and pickled onion. Ecuadorians eat it for breakfast and treat it as a hangover cure.

recipes.name: Eru
recipes.summary: A Cameroonian stew of finely shredded eru leaf with waterleaf and palm oil.

recipes.name: Erwtensoep
recipes.summary: A thick split pea soup with smoked sausage, dense enough for a spoon to stand in it.

recipes.name: Fabada asturiana
recipes.summary: Large white fabes beans stewed with chorizo, morcilla and cured pork.

recipes.name: Fahsa
recipes.summary: Boiling lamb stew in a stone bowl, topped with frothy fenugreek hulba.

recipes.name: Fanesca
recipes.summary: The Holy Week soup of twelve grains and pulses with salt cod.

recipes.name: Fårikål
recipes.summary: Mutton and cabbage in layers with whole peppercorns. Four ingredients and two hours.

recipes.name: Fattet hummus
recipes.summary: Layers of fried pita, hot chickpeas and garlic yoghurt with browned butter and pine nuts.

recipes.name: Fattoush
recipes.summary: A salad of vegetables and herbs with fried pieces of flatbread and sumac.

recipes.name: Feijoada
recipes.summary: Black beans stewed with several cuts of smoked and salted pork, served with orange and greens.

recipes.name: Fërgesë
recipes.summary: An Albanian bake of peppers, tomatoes and curd cheese, served in its clay pan.

recipes.name: Fesenjan
recipes.summary: Duck or chicken in a thick sauce of ground walnuts and pomegranate molasses.

recipes.name: Fish amok
recipes.nativeName: អាម៉ុកត្រី
recipes.summary: Fish in a coconut curry, steamed in a cup folded from banana leaf.

recipes.name: Fish and chips
recipes.summary: Cod in beer batter with twice-fried chips. The batter lives on cold and on the gas in the beer.

recipes.name: Flia
recipes.summary: A layered pie of thin batter, poured one layer at a time under a heated iron lid called a saç.

recipes.name: Cheese fondue
recipes.summary: Gruyère and Vacherin melted in white wine with starch. The acidity of the wine keeps the cheese from seizing.

recipes.name: Piri-piri chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken spatchcocked and grilled over coals under a sauce of piri-piri, garlic and lemon.

recipes.name: French onion soup
recipes.summary: Soup from onions, stock and cheese-topped bread. All of the flavour comes from caramelisation, which takes forty minutes rather than twenty.

recipes.name: Frikadeller
recipes.summary: Danish meat patties — flat rather than round — fried in butter to a dark crust.

recipes.name: Fritule
recipes.summary: Small doughnuts with raisins, citrus zest and rakija, deep-fried.

recipes.name: Ful medames
recipes.summary: Fava beans stewed to a cream with olive oil, lemon and cumin.

recipes.name: Sudanese ful
recipes.summary: Ful beans cooked soft and mashed in the pot, with sesame oil, cheese and egg.

recipes.name: Galayet bandora
recipes.summary: Tomatoes cooked down in olive oil with chilli and garlic to a thick sauce.

recipes.name: Galbijjim
recipes.summary: Beef short ribs braised in soy with pear, until the meat falls from the bone.

recipes.name: Gallo pinto
recipes.summary: Yesterday's rice fried with black beans and Salsa Lizano. The Costa Rican breakfast, every day.

recipes.name: Nicaraguan gallo pinto
recipes.summary: Rice fried with red beans. The Nicaraguan version: red beans, and no Salsa Lizano.

recipes.name: Garudhiya
recipes.summary: A clear broth of fresh tuna, cooked in water with salt and almost nothing else.

recipes.name: Gata
recipes.summary: A layered sweet bread with khoriz, a dry filling of flour, butter and sugar.

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.summary: A cold tomato soup blended with bread and oil into an emulsion — that is what makes it thick rather than watery.

recipes.name: Gemista
recipes.summary: Tomatoes and peppers stuffed with herbed rice and baked with potatoes in olive oil.

recipes.name: Ghapama
recipes.summary: A whole pumpkin baked with rice, dried fruit and nuts. A festive dish, cut open at the table.

recipes.name: Ghormeh sabzi
recipes.summary: Lamb stewed with a mountain of herbs, beans and dried lime. The herbs are fried until nearly black.

recipes.name: Gibanica
recipes.summary: A pie of crumpled filo sheets in a cheese and egg custard, baked to browned ridges.

recipes.name: Gỏi cuốn
recipes.summary: Fresh rice paper rolls with prawn, pork, noodles and herbs, never fried.

recipes.name: Gong bao chicken
recipes.summary: Diced chicken with peanuts and dried chillies in a sauce where the vinegar matters more than the sugar.

recipes.name: Goulash
recipes.summary: Beef stewed with onion and paprika. There is as much onion by weight as meat, and it dissolves into the sauce.

recipes.name: Gravlaks
recipes.summary: Salmon cured for two days under a weight with salt, sugar and dill. No heat and no smoke.

recipes.name: Gromperekichelcher
recipes.summary: Potato fritters with onion and parsley, deep-fried crisp. Christmas market food.

recipes.name: Gua bao
recipes.summary: A steamed folded bun with braised pork belly, pickled greens and peanut sugar.

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.summary: Avocado, lime, onion and chilli crushed with a fork. No blender and no sour cream: both turn it into a dip rather than guacamole.

recipes.name: Beef and stout stew
recipes.summary: Beef braised three hours in dark stout with onion and root vegetables.

recipes.name: Gundruk soup
recipes.summary: A sour soup of fermented dried greens with potato, soybeans and chilli.

recipes.name: Gurasa
recipes.summary: A thick Sudanese pan bread, served with meat stew or sauce.

recipes.name: Gyudon
recipes.summary: Thinly sliced beef simmered with onion in dashi, soy and mirin, over rice.

recipes.name: Sweet cream of beans
recipes.summary: A sweet dessert cream of red beans with coconut milk, sweet potato and biscuits.

recipes.name: Hainanese chicken rice
recipes.summary: A whole chicken poached below boiling and rice cooked in its broth, with three sauces.

recipes.name: Halászlé
recipes.summary: A fiery red fisherman's soup on paprika, made from river fish in a cauldron.

recipes.name: Haleem
recipes.summary: Meat, wheat and pulses cooked down and beaten into one smooth thick mass over six hours.

recipes.name: Hallaca
recipes.summary: Corn dough with a meat guiso, olives and raisins, wrapped in banana leaf.

recipes.name: Grilled halloumi with watermelon
recipes.summary: Cypriot cheese seared to a crust, with cold watermelon and mint. The island's summer plate.

recipes.name: Hāngī-style chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken and root vegetables wrapped and baked with smoked salt — a home version of the Māori earth oven.

recipes.name: Harees
recipes.summary: Wheat and meat cooked down and beaten into one smooth mass. Ramadan food across the Gulf.

recipes.name: Harira
recipes.summary: A thick soup of lentils, chickpeas and tomato, bound with a flour slurry and finished with lemon.

recipes.name: Hong shao rou
recipes.summary: Pork belly braised in caramel and soy until it glistens. The classic of red-braising.

recipes.name: Hoppers
recipes.summary: Thin bowl-shaped pancakes from fermented rice batter with coconut milk, often with an egg.

recipes.name: Horiatiki salad
recipes.summary: The village salad, with no leaves in it: tomato, cucumber, onion, olives and a whole slab of feta on top.

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.summary: Chickpeas whipped with tahini, lemon and iced water to a cream. The skins come off.

recipes.name: Ichlekli
recipes.summary: A large closed pie of mutton and onion baked in ashes. The dish of Turkmen herders.

recipes.name: Imqaret
recipes.summary: Maltese pastry diamonds with an aniseed date filling, deep-fried.

recipes.name: Indio viejo
recipes.summary: A thick stew of shredded beef, thickened with corn masa and mint.

recipes.name: Injera
recipes.summary: A sour, porous flatbread of teff on a three-day ferment, serving as both bread and plate.

recipes.name: Iraqi biryani
recipes.summary: Rice with chicken, vermicelli, nuts and raisins, every component cooked separately.

recipes.name: Irish stew
recipes.summary: Lamb with potato and onion, stewed without browning. The meat is never seared, and that is the whole point.

recipes.name: İskender kebab
recipes.summary: Slices of döner over pieces of pide, under tomato sauce, melted butter and yoghurt.

recipes.name: Jamaican patties
recipes.summary: Pastries of turmeric-yellow flaky dough with a spiced beef filling.

recipes.name: Jareesh
recipes.summary: Cracked wheat cooked with meat to a thick porridge, under fried onion.

recipes.name: Jasha maroo
recipes.summary: Chopped chicken in a thin broth with ginger, garlic and chilli. Bhutanese everyday cooking.

recipes.name: Jerk chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken in a marinade of scotch bonnet and allspice, smoked over pimento wood.

recipes.name: Jiaozi dumplings
recipes.summary: Pork and cabbage dumplings, fried and then steamed in the same covered pan.

recipes.name: Jollof rice
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in a thick sauce of tomato, pepper and onion. The sauce is reduced dark before the rice goes in.

recipes.name: Joojeh kabab
recipes.summary: Chicken in a saffron marinade with onion juice and lemon, grilled over coals.

recipes.name: Jota
recipes.summary: A thick soup of soured turnip or sauerkraut with beans, potato and smoked meat.

recipes.name: Judd mat Gaardebounen
recipes.summary: Smoked pork collar, soaked and boiled, with broad beans in a cream sauce. Luxembourg's national dish.

recipes.name: Kabsa
recipes.summary: Rice with chicken in a spiced broth with dried lime and tomato. The centrepiece of the Saudi table.

recipes.name: Kabuli pulao
recipes.summary: Rice with lamb under a layer of caramelised carrot, raisins and almonds. Afghanistan's national dish.

recipes.name: Kačamak
recipes.summary: Maize porridge with potato, beaten with cheese and kajmak until it pulls into threads.

recipes.name: Käsespätzle
recipes.summary: Swabian egg noodles layered with cheese and buried under fried onion.

recipes.name: Kak'ik
recipes.summary: A red turkey soup with charred chillies and spices, a dish of the Q'eqchi' Maya.

recipes.name: Kama
recipes.summary: A dessert of roasted mixed-grain flour stirred into kefir. Estonian breakfast and summer pudding at once.

recipes.name: Kanelbullar
recipes.summary: Cinnamon buns knotted rather than rolled. The cardamom in the dough matters more than the cinnamon inside.

recipes.name: Kapustnica
recipes.summary: A soup of sauerkraut with smoked meat, sausage and dried mushrooms. The Slovak Christmas table.

recipes.name: Kare-kare
recipes.summary: Oxtail in a thick peanut sauce with vegetables, served with bagoong shrimp paste.

recipes.name: Karelian pies
recipes.summary: A rye shell filled with rice porridge, brushed with butter out of the oven and served with egg butter.

recipes.name: Katsudon
recipes.summary: A breaded pork cutlet finished in sweet-salt broth with egg and slid onto rice.

recipes.name: Kavarma
recipes.summary: Pork with mushrooms and peppers, stewed in a clay pot under an egg.

recipes.name: Kaya toast
recipes.summary: Toasted bread with kaya coconut egg jam and cold butter, with soft-boiled eggs.

recipes.name: Kedjenou
recipes.summary: Chicken cooked in a sealed clay pot without water. An Ivorian dish of slow heat.

recipes.name: Key lime pie
recipes.summary: A condensed milk and lime filling on a cracker crumb base, set by acid rather than heat.

recipes.name: Imeretian khachapuri
recipes.summary: A round flatbread with the cheese inside rather than on top. The dough is made on matsoni, and there is as much filling as there is dough.

recipes.name: Khao soi
recipes.summary: Northern Thai noodles in coconut curry, boiled noodles in the broth and fried ones on top.

recipes.name: Khinkali
recipes.summary: Purses of stiff dough holding chopped meat and broth. The broth appears on its own, from water worked into the filling.

recipes.name: Kholodnik
recipes.summary: A cold beetroot soup on kefir with sorrel, cucumber and egg, pink and sharply sour.

recipes.name: Khuushuur
recipes.summary: Mongolian fried lamb pasties, flat and crisp, made for Naadam.

recipes.name: Kibbeh bil sanieh
recipes.summary: Two layers of bulgur and meat with a filling of mince and pine nuts between them, baked in a tray.

recipes.name: Kibbeh nayyeh
recipes.summary: Raw kibbeh: the freshest lamb pounded with bulgur and spices, served under olive oil.

recipes.name: Kimchi jjigae
recipes.summary: A stew of over-fermented kimchi with pork and tofu. The older the kimchi, the better it works.

recipes.name: Kitfo
recipes.summary: Hand-chopped raw beef worked with spiced niter kibbeh butter and mitmita spice.

recipes.name: Kjötsúpa
recipes.summary: A clear lamb soup with root vegetables and barley. One pot, four ingredients, three hours.

recipes.name: Kjøttkaker
recipes.summary: Large meat patties in a brown sauce, with lingonberry and stewed peas.

recipes.name: Kleftiko
recipes.summary: Lamb baked five hours in sealed clay with not a drop of water.

recipes.name: Kleicha
recipes.summary: Biscuits of date paste and cardamom, rolled into a log and cut into slices.

recipes.name: Köttbullar
recipes.summary: Meatballs on a panade of bread and cream, in a cream sauce, with lingonberry and mashed potato.

recipes.name: Kohuke
recipes.summary: A curd bar in chocolate glaze, the Estonian dessert from the fridge.

recipes.name: Koki
recipes.summary: A pudding of ground black-eyed beans with palm oil, steamed in banana leaves.

recipes.name: Kalduny
recipes.summary: Potato pancakes with a meat filling inside, fried and then stewed in soured cream.

recipes.name: Koshari
recipes.summary: Rice, lentils and pasta in one bowl under a vinegary tomato sauce and fried onion.

recipes.name: Kottu roti
recipes.summary: Godamba roti chopped on the griddle with vegetables, egg and curry, worked with two cleavers.

recipes.name: Koupepia
recipes.summary: Cypriot vine leaves rolled with rice, mince and cinnamon, finished with lemon.

recipes.name: Carniolan sausage
recipes.summary: A boiled pork sausage with garlic, served with horseradish and mustard, protected by origin.

recipes.name: Kufta bozbash
recipes.summary: A clear broth with one large meatball per portion, a dried plum and apricot hidden inside it.

recipes.name: Kugelis
recipes.summary: A potato bake from raw grated potato with bacon and onion, served with soured cream.

recipes.name: Kulajda
recipes.summary: A creamy mushroom soup with dill, potato and a poached egg, sharpened with vinegar.

recipes.name: Kunafa
recipes.summary: Fine shredded pastry with a cheese filling, baked and drenched in sugar syrup.

recipes.name: Qurutob
recipes.summary: Flaky fatir bread soaked in reconstituted dried qurut, under fried onion and fresh vegetables.

recipes.name: Kuurdak
recipes.summary: Lamb fried in its own tail fat with onion and potato.

recipes.name: Darabeel
recipes.summary: Kuwaiti buns of date paste and cardamom, rolled into spirals.

recipes.name: Kuwaiti gereesh
recipes.summary: Cracked wheat cooked down with chicken and tomato to a thick porridge under fried onion.

recipes.name: Kuyrdak
recipes.summary: Offal and meat fried in a cauldron with onion and potato on rendered tail fat.

recipes.name: Kyiv cake
recipes.summary: Two meringue layers with nuts, filled with a charlotte buttercream.

recipes.name: Lagman
recipes.summary: Hand-pulled noodles with a meat and vegetable sauce called vaja. A Dungan dish that became common across Central Asia.

recipes.name: Lahmacun
recipes.summary: A paper-thin flatbread with lamb and pepper paste, baked three minutes in a screaming oven.

recipes.name: Lahpet thoke
recipes.nativeName: လက်ဖက်သုပ်
recipes.summary: A salad of fermented tea leaves with fried beans, nuts and garlic.

recipes.name: Laksa lemak
recipes.summary: Noodles in a coconut broth built on a rempah paste, with prawns and tofu. The paste is fried until the oil separates.

recipes.name: Katong laksa
recipes.summary: Rice noodles in a coconut broth with prawns, cut short and eaten with a spoon only.

recipes.name: Lamingtons
recipes.summary: Cubes of sponge dipped in chocolate icing and rolled in desiccated coconut.

recipes.name: Lampuki pie
recipes.summary: The Maltese pie of dorado with spinach, olives and cauliflower.

recipes.name: Lángos
recipes.summary: A yeasted flatbread deep-fried, rubbed with garlic and buried under soured cream and cheese.

recipes.name: Larb
recipes.summary: Chopped meat with toasted rice powder, herbs and lime. The national dish of Laos.

recipes.name: Lasagne alla bolognese
recipes.summary: Layers of pasta, ragù and béchamel. The ragù simmers three hours on milk and wine rather than tomato.

recipes.name: Leche flan
recipes.summary: A dense caramel custard made on yolks alone, steamed in a metal mould.

recipes.name: Liboke de poisson
recipes.summary: Spiced fish wrapped in a banana leaf and baked in embers.

recipes.name: Llapingachos
recipes.summary: Potato cakes with cheese inside, fried in achiote oil and served with a peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Lohikeitto
recipes.summary: Finnish salmon soup with potato and cream, a heap of dill and a knob of butter in the bowl.

recipes.name: Lok lak
recipes.summary: Cubes of beef seared over high heat, on salad, with a dip of lime and black pepper.

recipes.name: Lomo saltado
recipes.summary: Beef seared in a wok with onion and tomato, served with both chips and rice at once.

recipes.name: Lu rou fan
recipes.summary: Minced pork belly braised in soy sauce with spices, spooned over white rice.

recipes.name: Luqaimat
recipes.summary: Crisp balls of yeasted batter in date syrup. The Ramadan sweet of the Gulf.

recipes.name: Machanka
recipes.summary: A thick pork and sausage gravy on soured cream, into which pancakes are dipped. Hence the name.

recipes.name: Machboos
recipes.summary: Rice with prawns or chicken on the bizar spice mix with dried lime. The staple of the Gulf.

recipes.name: Makroud
recipes.summary: Semolina diamonds with a date filling, fried and steeped in honey.

recipes.name: Malabi
recipes.summary: A milk pudding set with cornflour and rose water, under a sweet syrup and nuts.

recipes.name: Maltese rabbit stew
recipes.summary: Rabbit stewed in red wine with garlic and bay. The national dish of Malta.

recipes.name: Mămăligă
recipes.summary: A firm cornmeal porridge, cut with a thread rather than a knife.

recipes.name: Mandazi
recipes.summary: Triangular doughnuts on coconut milk with cardamom, lightly sweet, for tea.

recipes.name: Mangú
recipes.summary: Mashed boiled green plantain with pickled onion, egg, fried cheese and salami.

recipes.name: Mansaf
recipes.summary: Lamb in a sauce of jameed, fermented dried yoghurt, over rice and flatbread. Jordan's national dish.

recipes.name: Turkish mantı
recipes.summary: Tiny lamb dumplings, boiled and served under garlic yoghurt and paprika butter.

recipes.name: Afghan mantu
recipes.summary: Steamed dumplings of beef and onion under garlic yoghurt and a yellow split pea sauce.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
recipes.summary: Tofu in a hot doubanjiang sauce with Sichuan pepper, which numbs rather than burns.

recipes.name: Maqdeed
recipes.summary: Sun-dried meat with turmeric, boiled and then fried with onion.

recipes.name: Maqluba
recipes.summary: Rice with meat and fried vegetables cooked in one pot and turned out whole onto a platter.

recipes.name: Mas huni
recipes.summary: Tuna worked with coconut, onion and lime, with hot roshi flatbread. The Maldivian breakfast.

recipes.name: Masala dosa
recipes.summary: A thin crisp crêpe of fermented rice and lentil batter with a spiced potato filling.

recipes.name: Masgouf
recipes.summary: River fish butterflied and cooked standing beside an open fire. A Baghdad dish from the banks of the Tigris.

recipes.name: Massaman curry
recipes.nativeName: แกงมัสมั่น
recipes.summary: A mild curry of beef, potato and peanuts, built on spices of the Muslim tradition.

recipes.name: Matapa
recipes.summary: Cassava leaves pounded with peanuts and coconut milk, with prawns. Mozambique's national dish.

recipes.name: Matoke
recipes.summary: Green bananas steamed in banana leaves and mashed to a purée. The staple of the Buganda table.

recipes.name: Mbejú
recipes.summary: A starch and cheese flatbread set in a dry pan without a drop of water.

recipes.name: Mchuzi wa samaki
recipes.summary: Tanzanian fish curry on coconut milk with tamarind and curry powder.

recipes.name: Australian meat pie
recipes.summary: A hand-sized pie with a thick beef filling: shortcrust base, puff lid, tomato sauce on top.

recipes.name: Melanzane alla parmigiana
recipes.summary: Layers of fried aubergine with tomato sauce, mozzarella and parmesan, baked to a crust.

recipes.name: Melktert
recipes.summary: A milk tart with cinnamon: a barely-egged custard filling in a shortcrust base.

recipes.name: Menemen
recipes.summary: Eggs cooked into tomatoes and green pepper. They are never beaten and rarely stirred, or you end up with ordinary scrambled eggs.

recipes.name: Mercimek çorbası
recipes.summary: A red lentil soup blended smooth and finished with lemon and paprika butter.

recipes.name: Milanesa a la napolitana
recipes.summary: A breaded cutlet under tomato sauce, ham and melted cheese.

recipes.name: Misir wat
recipes.summary: Red lentils in a berbere sauce. A fasting dish eaten in Ethiopia on fast days all year round.

recipes.name: Miso soup
recipes.summary: A soup of dashi and miso that takes ten minutes. Miso must never boil: boiling takes out both the aroma and the point of it.

recipes.name: Mohinga
recipes.nativeName: မုန့်ဟင်းခါး
recipes.summary: Rice noodles in a thick fish broth built on banana stem. Breakfast, and Myanmar's unofficial national dish.

recipes.name: Mole poblano
recipes.summary: Chicken in a dark sauce of several chillies, nuts, spices and chocolate.

recipes.name: Molokhia
recipes.summary: A soup of jute leaves, slippery in texture, with a garlic and coriander tempering.

recipes.name: Momo
recipes.summary: Nepali steamed dumplings of buffalo or chicken with an achar of charred tomato.

recipes.name: Montreal bagels
recipes.summary: Bagels boiled in honey water and baked in a wood oven, sweeter and thinner than New York's.

recipes.name: Montucas
recipes.summary: Fresh-corn tamales with chicken, steamed in corn husks.

recipes.name: Moqueca baiana
recipes.summary: Fish stewed in coconut milk with dendê palm oil, in a clay pot.

recipes.name: Moros y cristianos
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in the liquid from black beans, which darkens it and gives it all their flavour.

recipes.name: Moules marinières
recipes.summary: Mussels steamed in white wine with celery and onion. Five minutes under a lid, no longer.

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.summary: Aubergine, a meat sauce with cinnamon and a thick layer of béchamel, baked until it sets firm enough to cut.

recipes.name: Mucenici
recipes.summary: Yeast figures of eight glazed with honey and walnuts for the day of the Forty Martyrs.

recipes.name: Muhammara
recipes.summary: A paste of roasted red pepper, walnuts and pomegranate molasses, from Aleppo.

recipes.name: Mulgipuder
recipes.summary: A mash of potato and pearl barley with pork crackling. An Estonian dish recognised as a national symbol.

recipes.name: Murabyan
recipes.summary: Kuwaiti rice with prawns in a broth of their own shells, with dill and dried lime.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
recipes.summary: Yoghurt-marinated chicken, roasted, in a tomato and cream sauce finished with fenugreek.

recipes.name: Muriwo unedovi
recipes.summary: Collard greens stewed in peanut butter with tomato. The side to sadza in every household.

recipes.name: Musakhan
recipes.summary: Chicken with onion and sumac on taboon bread soaked in olive oil.

recipes.name: Nacatamal
recipes.summary: A large tamal of corn dough with pork, rice and potato, boiled in a banana leaf.

recipes.name: Nasi goreng
recipes.summary: Fried rice with a chilli and shrimp-paste base, sweet soy sauce and an egg on top.

recipes.name: Nasi lemak
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in coconut milk with pandan, served with sambal, anchovies, egg and peanuts.

recipes.name: Ndizi na nyama
recipes.summary: Green bananas stewed with beef in coconut milk. A Chagga dish from the slopes of Kilimanjaro.

recipes.name: Ndolé
recipes.summary: Bitter leaves with peanut paste, meat and prawns. The national dish of Cameroon.

recipes.name: Nihari
recipes.summary: Beef shin stewed overnight in a thick spiced gravy with marrow, bound with a wheat-flour slurry.

recipes.name: Nikujaga
recipes.summary: Beef and potato simmered in dashi with soy and mirin. The classic of Japanese home cooking.

recipes.name: Njeguški steak
recipes.summary: A pork chop with a pocket stuffed with Njeguši prosciutto and cheese, fried in breadcrumbs.

recipes.name: Num banh chok
recipes.summary: Cold rice noodles under a fish and coconut curry with a mountain of raw vegetables and herbs.

recipes.name: Nyama choma
recipes.summary: Goat meat grilled slowly over coals in large pieces, with kachumbari and ugali.

recipes.name: Ohn no khao swe
recipes.summary: Wheat noodles in a thick coconut broth with chicken and chickpea flour.

recipes.name: Ohrid trout
recipes.summary: Trout baked whole with lemon and herbs, from Lake Ohrid.

recipes.name: Ojja with merguez
recipes.summary: A fiery tomato stew with merguez lamb sausages and eggs stirred into the sauce.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki
recipes.summary: A thick cabbage pancake where the batter only binds. Yam in the batter gives it the airy texture.

recipes.name: Olla de carne
recipes.summary: The Costa Rican meat pot with cassava, squash, corn and plantain.

recipes.name: Omani halwa
recipes.summary: A chewy halwa of starch, rosewater and saffron, stirred two hours in a cauldron.

recipes.name: Mishkak
recipes.summary: Meat on skewers in a tamarind and spice marinade, grilled over coals at the roadside.

recipes.name: Tajik oshi palav
recipes.summary: Pilaf with mutton, yellow carrot and a whole head of garlic, recognised by UNESCO as heritage.

recipes.name: Osso buco alla milanese
recipes.summary: Veal shin braised two hours in wine and stock, finished with a gremolata of zest and garlic.

recipes.name: Pabellón criollo
recipes.summary: A plate in four parts: shredded stewed beef, black beans, white rice and fried plantain.

recipes.name: Pad krapow
recipes.summary: Minced pork fried with chilli, garlic and holy basil. Five minutes from start to plate.

recipes.name: Pad thai
recipes.summary: Rice noodles fried with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar. The whole thing takes four minutes.

recipes.name: Paella valenciana
recipes.summary: Rice in a wide pan with chicken, rabbit and beans. It is never stirred once, and the crust on the bottom depends on that.

recipes.name: Baku pakhlava
recipes.summary: Diamonds of eight layers of dough with a nut filling, under a saffron syrup.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
recipes.summary: Spinach blanched and blended, with cubes of paneer. Spinach must not be stewed or it goes brown.

recipes.name: Pão de queijo
recipes.summary: Cheese balls of tapioca starch — a crust outside, a stretchy hollow inside. No wheat and no yeast.

recipes.name: Papanași
recipes.summary: Curd doughnuts shaped as a ring with a ball on top, with soured cream and jam.

recipes.name: Pastel de choclo
recipes.summary: A bake of meat filling under a lid of ground sweetcorn, with an olive and an egg inside.

recipes.name: Pastel de nata
recipes.summary: Flaky pastry cases of custard baked in extreme heat until the surface blisters black.

recipes.name: Pastelitos
recipes.summary: Fried corn turnovers with meat and potato under a cabbage salad.

recipes.name: Pastilla
recipes.summary: A layered pie of pigeon or chicken with almonds and cinnamon, dusted with icing sugar.

recipes.name: Pastizzi
recipes.summary: Flaky pastries filled with ricotta or mushy peas. Maltese street food on every corner.

recipes.name: Pastrmajlija
recipes.summary: A yeast-dough boat with cured pork and an egg, from Štip.

recipes.name: Patatas bravas
recipes.summary: Twice-fried potato under a hot paprika sauce. The Madrid version has no tomato in it at all.

recipes.name: Pavlova
recipes.summary: A meringue with a crisp shell and a marshmallow centre, under whipped cream and kiwifruit.

recipes.name: Peka
recipes.summary: Meat and potatoes under an iron bell buried in embers, three hours untouched.

recipes.name: Pelau
recipes.summary: Rice with chicken, pigeon peas and coconut milk, browned in burnt sugar.

recipes.name: Grey peas with speck
recipes.summary: Grey peas cooked soft with onion and rendered smoked pork. Latvian winter and Christmas food.

recipes.name: Pelmeni
recipes.summary: Small dumplings of unleavened dough with chopped meat and onion, boiled in broth.

recipes.name: Pepián
recipes.summary: Chicken in a thick sauce of toasted seeds and chillies. One of Guatemala's oldest dishes.

recipes.name: Pesto alla genovese
recipes.summary: Basil ground with garlic and pine nuts. No heat and no blender — a mortar and a cool room.

recipes.name: Phở bò
recipes.summary: A clear beef broth with charred ginger and whole spices, rice noodles, and beef that finishes cooking in the bowl.

recipes.name: Pierogi ruskie
recipes.summary: Dumplings of potato and curd cheese, served with fried onion and soured cream.

recipes.name: Pineapple cake
recipes.summary: Squares of shortcrust with a dense filling of reduced pineapple and winter melon.

recipes.name: Pique macho
recipes.summary: A mountain of chips with beef, sausage, egg and fiery locoto chillies.

recipes.name: Pizza margherita
recipes.summary: A long-fermented dough, uncooked tomato, mozzarella and basil. Time decides everything here, not the number of ingredients.

recipes.name: Plăcintă
recipes.summary: A flat pie of stretched dough with cheese, pumpkin or apple, cooked in a dry pan.

recipes.name: Plokkfiskur
recipes.summary: Flaked boiled fish mashed with potato in a white sauce. Icelandic home cooking made from leftovers.

recipes.name: Uzbek plov
recipes.summary: Rice steamed over a zirvak of lamb, carrot and onion. It is never stirred once it goes in.

recipes.name: Poffertjes
recipes.summary: Tiny yeasted pancakes of buckwheat and wheat flour, served with butter and icing sugar.

recipes.name: Pol sambol
recipes.summary: Fresh coconut pounded with chilli, onion and lime. Five minutes to make and served with everything.

recipes.name: Pollo guisado
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in caramelised sugar with vegetables, the Dominican weekday lunch.

recipes.name: Poronkäristys
recipes.summary: Shaved reindeer fried in butter and braised in beer, with mash and lingonberry.

recipes.name: Potica
recipes.summary: A yeasted roll with a walnut filling, coiled into a ring. Slovenian baking for every celebration.

recipes.name: Poulet DG
recipes.summary: Fried chicken with fried plantain and vegetables. The dish called "the director general's chicken".

recipes.name: Poulet moambé
recipes.summary: Chicken in a sauce of palm fruit pulp. The national dish of the Congo.

recipes.name: Poutine
recipes.summary: Chips with cheese curds under hot gravy. The Québécois street classic.

recipes.name: Pozole rojo
recipes.summary: A soup of pork and hominy in a dried chilli broth, with a pile of fresh garnishes on the table.

recipes.name: Puff puff
recipes.summary: Yeasted balls of loose batter, deep-fried crisp outside and airy within.

recipes.name: Pulled pork
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder smoked ten hours at low heat and pulled into threads.

recipes.name: Pulpo a feira
recipes.summary: Boiled octopus on a wooden board with paprika, coarse salt and olive oil.

recipes.name: Cantonese steamed fish
recipes.summary: A whole fish steamed with ginger and spring onion, finished with smoking oil and soy.

recipes.name: Quiche lorraine
recipes.summary: A shortcrust base with bacon and a cream and egg custard. No cheese and no onion — the classical recipe has neither.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.summary: A Provençal vegetable stew where each vegetable is cooked separately before they meet — otherwise it turns to mush.

recipes.name: Ravitoto
recipes.summary: Pounded cassava leaves stewed with pork and coconut milk.

recipes.name: Rechta
recipes.summary: Algerian handmade noodles steamed over broth and dressed with a white chicken sauce.

recipes.name: Rellenitos
recipes.summary: Balls of ripe plantain purée filled with sweetened black beans and chocolate.

recipes.name: Rendang
recipes.summary: Beef simmered in coconut milk for four hours, until the milk turns to oil and starts frying the meat.

recipes.name: Rice and peas
recipes.summary: Rice cooked with red beans in coconut milk, with thyme and a whole scotch bonnet.

recipes.name: Rinderrouladen
recipes.summary: Thin slices of beef rolled around mustard, bacon and gherkin and braised until they give way.

recipes.name: Risalamande
recipes.summary: A cold rice pudding with whipped cream and almonds, under a hot cherry sauce.

recipes.name: Risotto alla milanese
recipes.summary: A saffron risotto built on stock and near-constant stirring, which is what pulls the starch out of the rice and makes it creamy.

recipes.name: Roast beef with Yorkshire pudding
recipes.summary: A beef joint roasted whole, with an airy batter pudding baked in beef dripping.

recipes.name: Rösti
recipes.summary: A potato cake of coarsely grated potato fried crisp on both sides. The potatoes are boiled the day before.

recipes.name: Rogan josh
recipes.summary: Kashmiri lamb in a yoghurt sauce with Kashmiri chilli, red from the chilli rather than from heat.

recipes.name: Rolex
recipes.summary: A vegetable omelette rolled in a chapati. Kampala street food, the name a slur of "rolled eggs".

recipes.name: Romazava
recipes.summary: Meat in broth with brèdes mafana, a bitter green that makes the mouth tingle.

recipes.name: Ropa vieja
recipes.summary: Beef pulled into strands and stewed in sofrito with peppers and olives. The meat is boiled whole in advance.

recipes.name: Panamanian ropa vieja
recipes.summary: Shredded beef in tomato sauce with olives and capers, in the Panamanian style — drier than the Cuban.

recipes.name: Roti canai
recipes.summary: A flatbread stretched translucent and crumpled before frying. The layers come from air rather than butter.

recipes.name: Icelandic rye bread
recipes.summary: A sweet dark rye bread baked in a sealed tin for twelve hours at a low temperature.

recipes.name: Ruisleipä
recipes.summary: A dense sourdough rye bread, sour and with almost no wheat flour in it.

recipes.name: Rye bread layer dessert
recipes.summary: Layers of dark rye breadcrumbs, whipped cream and cranberry jam.

recipes.name: Sabich
recipes.summary: Pita with fried aubergine, boiled egg, amba and salad. The Iraqi-Israeli street classic.

recipes.name: Sachertorte
recipes.summary: A dense chocolate sponge with apricot jam under a mirror chocolate glaze.

recipes.name: Sadza ne nyama
recipes.summary: Stiff maize porridge with stewed beef and greens. The daily meal of Zimbabwe.

recipes.name: Šakotis
recipes.summary: A spiked tree cake baked layer by layer on a turning spit over a fire.

recipes.name: Salata aswad
recipes.summary: A Sudanese salad of fried aubergine with peanut butter and lemon.

recipes.name: Home-cured salo
recipes.summary: Pork back fat dry-cured with garlic and spices, matured in the cold for a week.

recipes.name: Saltah
recipes.summary: A meat stew served boiling in a stone pot under a whipped fenugreek froth called hulba.

recipes.name: Salteñas
recipes.summary: Baked pastries whose filling stays liquid inside. The Bolivian mid-morning snack.

recipes.name: Šaltibarščiai
recipes.summary: A cold beetroot soup on kefir, vivid pink, with cucumber, dill and boiled potatoes served alongside.

recipes.name: Samgyetang
recipes.summary: A whole young chicken stuffed with glutinous rice and ginseng, simmered in its own broth.

recipes.name: Samlor korko
recipes.summary: A thick vegetable soup with toasted ground rice, pork and prahok, from a dozen vegetables.

recipes.name: Samosa
recipes.summary: Triangles of potato and pea in a ghee-rich pastry. Fried on a moderate flame, never a fierce one.

recipes.name: Samsa
recipes.summary: Flaky triangles of chopped lamb and onion, baked to a crisp shell.

recipes.name: Colombian sancocho
recipes.summary: A chicken soup with cassava, plantain and corn, cooked over an open fire.

recipes.name: Dominican sancocho
recipes.summary: A thick soup of several meats and root vegetables. Celebration food, cooked for a crowd.

recipes.name: Panamanian sancocho
recipes.summary: Chicken soup with ñame root and culantro. Panama's cure for a hangover and for a cold.

recipes.name: Sardinhas assadas
recipes.summary: Whole sardines salted coarsely and grilled over coals, served on a slice of bread.

recipes.name: Sarma
recipes.summary: Rolls of soured cabbage leaves with pork and rice, stewed with smoked meat.

recipes.name: Sarmale
recipes.summary: Cabbage rolls in soured leaves with pork and rice, braised three hours under a layer of shredded cabbage.

recipes.name: Moldovan sarmale
recipes.summary: Small rolls of soured cabbage stewed with smoked meat under a blanket of leaves.

recipes.name: Sate ayam
recipes.summary: Chicken skewers over coals with a thick peanut sauce and sweet kecap manis.

recipes.name: Satsivi
recipes.summary: Turkey or chicken in a cold walnut sauce with garlic and spices. The Georgian New Year table.

recipes.name: Sauerbraten
recipes.summary: Beef steeped for days in a vinegar marinade and braised in it, with a gravy thickened on gingerbread.

recipes.name: Swabian potato salad
recipes.summary: Potato dressed in warm stock with vinegar and oil. No mayonnaise — southern Germany does not admit it here.

recipes.name: Black Forest gateau
recipes.summary: Chocolate sponge soaked in kirsch, with whipped cream and sour cherries.

recipes.name: Schweinshaxe
recipes.summary: Pork knuckle roasted to a glassy crackling, with dark beer and sauerkraut.

recipes.name: Seekh kebab
recipes.summary: Spiced mince moulded onto a skewer and grilled over coals.

recipes.name: Sel roti
recipes.summary: A ring of fermented rice batter deep-fried crisp outside and soft within.

recipes.name: Selsko meso
recipes.summary: Pork stewed with mushrooms, onion and wine in an individual clay pot, under cheese.

recipes.name: Sernik
recipes.summary: A dense curd cheesecake on a shortcrust base, made with twaróg rather than cream cheese.

recipes.name: Sfiha
recipes.summary: Open flatbreads with minced lamb, tomato and pomegranate molasses, from Baalbek.

recipes.name: Shah plov
recipes.summary: Pilaf baked in a crown of lavash. The crust holds its shape and is cut in wedges like a pie.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in a thick sauce of tomato and pepper with cumin and paprika.

recipes.name: Tunisian chakchouka
recipes.summary: Stewed peppers with tomato and harissa, eggs broken into the sauce at the end.

recipes.name: Tunisian lablabi
recipes.summary: Chickpeas in a garlic broth poured over torn stale bread, with an egg, cumin and harissa.

recipes.name: Shan noodles
recipes.summary: Rice noodles with a tomato and chicken sauce, pickled greens and ground peanuts.

recipes.name: Shelpek
recipes.summary: Thin flatbreads fried in oil, the memorial bread of Kazakh tradition.

recipes.name: Shepherd's pie
recipes.summary: Lamb in a thick gravy under mashed potato, baked to a browned crust.

recipes.name: Shish barak
recipes.summary: Small lamb dumplings baked and then cooked in a garlic and mint yoghurt sauce.

recipes.name: Shopska salad
recipes.summary: Tomato, cucumber and pepper under a cap of grated white cheese. The vegetables are cut large, the cheese grated fine.

recipes.name: Shorshe ilish
recipes.summary: Hilsa in a ground mustard sauce, cooked by steaming. The great fish of Bengal.

recipes.name: Shoyu ramen
recipes.summary: Broth, tare and oil — three separate things assembled in the bowl rather than cooked together.

recipes.name: Shurpa
recipes.summary: A clear mutton soup with coarsely cut vegetables and a mound of herbs in the bowl.

recipes.name: Shuwa
recipes.summary: Lamb in a spice paste, wrapped in leaves and cooked for a full day. Oman's dish for Eid.

recipes.name: Silpancho
recipes.summary: A plate-sized breaded steak over rice and potatoes, topped with a fried egg and raw salsa.

recipes.name: Sinigang
recipes.summary: A sour tamarind soup with pork and vegetables. Sourness is the main flavour here, not an accent.

recipes.name: Skābputra
recipes.summary: Cold barley porridge on soured milk, Latvian field-day food.

recipes.name: Sklandrausis
recipes.summary: A rye pastry case with two layers of purée, potato and carrot, dusted with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Skolebrød
recipes.summary: A cardamom-scented bun with custard in the centre, icing and desiccated coconut.

recipes.name: Skyr with berries
recipes.summary: Home-made skyr, the Icelandic cultured dairy, strained thick, with bilberries.

recipes.name: Buchty
recipes.summary: Yeast buns with plum jam or curd, baked packed together so their sides fuse.

recipes.name: Smørrebrød
recipes.summary: An open sandwich on rye with butter. The order of the layers and the thickness of the butter both matter.

recipes.name: Soda bread
recipes.summary: Bread on bicarbonate and buttermilk, with no yeast and no proving. Three minutes from mixing to oven.

recipes.name: Meat solyanka
recipes.summary: A soup on strong stock with several meats, brined cucumbers, olives and lemon.

recipes.name: Conch soup
recipes.summary: Conch soup in coconut milk with cassava and plantain. The Garifuna cooking of the Caribbean coast.

recipes.name: Sopa paraguaya
recipes.summary: A dense corn and cheese bake with onion which, despite its name, is eaten with a fork.

recipes.name: Soto ayam
recipes.summary: A yellow chicken broth on turmeric and lemongrass, with noodles, egg and fried shallot.

recipes.name: Souvla
recipes.summary: Large pieces of pork or lamb on a spit, turning slowly over coals for two hours.

recipes.name: Souvlaki
recipes.summary: Pork on skewers in lemon, oregano and olive oil, cooked fast over a fierce heat.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
recipes.summary: Pasta from four ingredients: guanciale, eggs, pecorino and pepper. There is no cream in it and never was.

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.summary: A filo pie of spinach and feta. The spinach is squeezed bone dry, or the base stays raw.

recipes.name: Spas
recipes.summary: A soup of matsun and wheat groats. The whole difficulty is keeping the yoghurt base from splitting.

recipes.name: Sri Lankan fish curry
recipes.summary: Fish in a coconut curry soured with goraka and built on roasted curry powder.

recipes.name: Stamppot
recipes.summary: Mashed potato crushed together with curly kale, with smoked sausage and a well of gravy.

recipes.name: Stegt flæsk
recipes.summary: Slices of pork belly fried crisp, with potatoes and a parsley sauce.

recipes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
recipes.summary: A moist date sponge under a hot sauce of cream and dark sugar.

recipes.name: Štruklji
recipes.summary: A roll of thin dough with a curd filling, boiled in cloth and cut into rounds.

recipes.name: Sukuma wiki
recipes.summary: Collard greens stewed with onion and tomato. The everyday accompaniment to ugali across East Africa.

recipes.name: Suutei tsai
recipes.summary: Mongolian salted milk tea with butter, boiled rather than brewed.

recipes.name: Suya
recipes.summary: Beef skewers in a ground peanut and spice rub, applied twice — before and after grilling.

recipes.name: Svíčková na smetaně
recipes.summary: Beef in a purée of root vegetables with cream, served with dumplings, lingonberry and lemon.

recipes.name: Syrniki
recipes.summary: Curd cheese fritters with as much curd as possible and exactly enough flour to keep them together.

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
recipes.summary: A parsley salad with a little bulgur in it, not the other way round. There is ten times more herb than grain.

recipes.name: Tacos al pastor
recipes.summary: Pork in a marinade of dried chillies and pineapple, seared to caramelised edges, in a corn tortilla.

recipes.name: Tafelspitz
recipes.summary: Beef rump boiled in a clear broth, with apple horseradish and fried potatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken tagine with preserved lemon
recipes.summary: Chicken braised with preserved lemons and olives. The sourness comes from the peel, not the flesh.

recipes.name: Tahdig
recipes.summary: Rice with a golden crust on the bottom of the pot, made from rice, potato or flatbread.

recipes.name: Tam mak hoong
recipes.summary: Green papaya salad pounded in a mortar. The Lao version, made with fermented fish padaek.

recipes.name: Guatemalan tamales
recipes.summary: Corn dough with meat and recado sauce, wrapped in banana leaf and steamed.

recipes.name: Tarator
recipes.summary: A cold yoghurt soup with cucumber, garlic, dill and walnuts.

recipes.name: Tarte Tatin
recipes.summary: An upside-down apple tart: the apples caramelise at the bottom, the pastry goes on top and becomes the base.

recipes.name: Tavče gravče
recipes.summary: White beans baked in a clay pan with onion, paprika and peppers. North Macedonia's national dish.

recipes.name: Tavë Elbasani
recipes.summary: Lamb with rice under a yoghurt sauce, baked in an earthenware dish to a browned crust.

recipes.name: Tavë kosi
recipes.summary: Lamb baked under a thick yoghurt custard with egg and rice. Albania's national dish.

recipes.name: Tempura
recipes.summary: Vegetables and prawns in an ice-cold lumpy batter. Whisking it smooth is exactly what must not happen.

recipes.name: Thieboudienne
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in the tomato broth from the fish, with herb-stuffed fish and vegetables. Senegal's national dish.

recipes.name: Tigadegena
recipes.summary: Meat in a thick peanut sauce with vegetables. The Malian Sunday lunch.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.summary: Savoiardi in coffee under a mascarpone cream. No baking, but two places where it can go wrong.

recipes.name: Toast Skagen
recipes.summary: Prawns in a dill mayonnaise on fried bread, with roe on top.

recipes.name: Tom yum goong
recipes.summary: A hot and sour prawn soup where the balance is set at the end: fish sauce, lime and sugar go in to taste rather than by the recipe.

recipes.name: Torta frita
recipes.summary: Flat rounds made on rendered fat and deep-fried, which Uruguayans make when it rains.

recipes.name: Spanish tortilla
recipes.summary: A thick omelette of potato and onion, where the potato is not fried but poached in oil until it is nearly a purée.

recipes.name: Tostones
recipes.summary: Green plantain fried twice, flattened between the fryings, with a garlic dip.

recipes.name: Tourtière
recipes.summary: A double-crust pie of spiced pork and potato. The Québec Christmas table.

recipes.name: Trdelník
recipes.summary: A ribbon of yeasted dough wound round a spit, baked and rolled in sugar and nuts.

recipes.name: Trinidad roti
recipes.summary: A layered flatbread beaten into rags on the pan, served with chicken or goat curry.

recipes.name: Tsuivan
recipes.summary: Home-made noodles steamed directly over the meat, then tossed through it.

recipes.name: Tufahije
recipes.summary: Apples poached in syrup and filled with walnuts under whipped cream.

recipes.name: Tushbera
recipes.summary: Tajik dumplings in broth with herbs, boiled in thin dough and served in a bowl.

recipes.name: Cherry varenyky
recipes.summary: Dumplings of whole cherries and sugar. The juice stays inside if the fruit is tossed in starch first.

recipes.name: Pork with dumplings and cabbage
recipes.summary: Braised pork with bread dumplings and soured cabbage. Czechia's unofficial national dish.

recipes.name: Verivorst
recipes.summary: Blood sausage with pearl barley and marjoram, baked and served with lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Vigorón
recipes.summary: Boiled cassava with pork crackling and cabbage salad, served on a banana leaf.

recipes.name: Vitumbua
recipes.summary: Rice cakes on coconut milk, cooked in a pan of hemispherical wells.

recipes.name: Vori vori
recipes.summary: Chicken soup with corn-and-cheese dumplings, Paraguayan winter food.

recipes.name: Waakye
recipes.summary: Rice and black-eyed beans cooked with sorghum leaves, which turn it deep red.

recipes.name: Waterzooi
recipes.summary: A Ghent stew of chicken or fish in a creamy broth with julienned root vegetables.

recipes.name: Whitebait fritters
recipes.summary: Whitebait bound with egg and fried as a thin cake, with lemon and nothing else.

recipes.name: Wiener Schnitzel
recipes.summary: Veal beaten to three millimetres, crumbed and fried in plenty of fat until the coating puffs away.

recipes.name: Yangzhou fried rice
recipes.summary: Rice with prawns, ham and egg, where every grain stays separate under a thin film of egg.

recipes.name: Chicken yassa
recipes.summary: Chicken marinated in lemon under a mountain of caramelised onion with mustard.

recipes.name: Zagorje štrukli
recipes.summary: Thin dough with a curd filling, boiled and then baked under cream.

recipes.name: Zanzibar pilau
recipes.summary: Rice with beef on the island's spices: clove, cardamom, cinnamon and black pepper, and no turmeric at all.

recipes.name: Zeamă
recipes.summary: Chicken soup with home-made noodles, soured with bran borș. The Moldovan remedy for everything.

recipes.name: Zemiakové placky
recipes.summary: Thin potato pancakes with garlic and marjoram, fried crisp.

recipes.name: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes
recipes.summary: Veal strips in a creamy mushroom sauce with white wine, served with rösti.

recipes.name: Zurbian
recipes.summary: Yemeni rice with lamb and potato, coloured with saffron and baked sealed.

recipes.name: Żurek
recipes.summary: A sour soup on a rye starter with white sausage and egg. The sourness comes from fermentation, not vinegar.
